critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx:472-481 DashCarousel onScrollEnd uses onMomentumScrollEnd + onScrollEndDrag — on RN-Web a raw mouse-wheel scroll DOES scroll the ScrollView (CSS scroll-snap keeps it aligned) but does NOT fire either RN scroll-end event, so the active dot won't advance from mouse-wheel alone. This is a known RN-Web limitation and NOT a bug for the target mobile experience (touch swipe fires onScrollEndDrag correctly). Tap-to-jump path is the reliable web-preview fallback and works perfectly. Consider adding an `onScroll` handler (throttled) as a belt-and-braces sync if desktop-web accuracy ever matters.

index.tsx:465 contentPadH is hard-coded to spacing.lg*2 in a comment saying 'kept in sync with styles.content' — but the actual style key is `scroll` (line 748). Comment nit only; the value spacing.lg*2 does match paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg on both sides, so pageWidth math is correct.

index.tsx overall length is 1005 lines — approaching the >700 lines split threshold. The Bullion widgets (ActiveCarrierTripsCard, AssetsOnHandCard, SplitPill) could move to /src/components/dashboard/. Not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard carousel testIDs: dash-carousel (wrapper), dash-carousel-page-0..3 (per-page containers), dash-carousel-dots (dot row), dash-carousel-dot-0..3 (individual dot TouchableOpacity). To measure active-dot state reliably, DO NOT use `[data-testid=...] > div` — RN-Web wraps TouchableOpacity in extra divs. Instead read the innermost styled View via `document.querySelector('[data-testid="dash-carousel-dot-i"]').getBoundingClientRect()` OR check all descendant divs' backgroundColor (active=rgb(0,209,255) lime, inactive=rgb(100,116,139) textDim). Scroll offsets on tap: dot-0→scrollLeft=0, dot-1→370, dot-2→740, dot-3→1110 (each = i*(pageWidth+gap), pageWidth=358, gap=spacing.md=14 on 390px viewport). On RN-Web, mouse-wheel scroll advances the carousel visually but does NOT fire onMomentumScrollEnd/onScrollEndDrag so the active dot only re-syncs on a touch swipe or explicit dot tap — mention this if a follow-up review flags it as a 'drag doesn't update dot' bug.
